# Tubi Browse & Movies — Test Plan

**Generated by:** Playwright Test planner agent
**Generated test file:** `tests/m07/tubi-browse.spec.ts`

> Explored live against https://tubitv.com via MCP browser tools on 2026-09-24,
> pacing navigations well under the 1-request/second WAF limit called out in
> this repo's AGENTS.md. Every scenario below reflects verified live behavior;
> nothing is inferred.

---

## Scenario 1: The Browse menu opens from the top menubar

**Given** the user is on the Tubi home page
**When** they open "Browse" from the top menubar
**Then** the "Browse" menu item is expanded
**And** a "Browse Categories" submenu becomes visible with at least one category item inside it

## Scenario 2: The Movies page reached via Browse shows content tiles

**Given** the user is on the Tubi home page
**When** they open "Movies" from the top menubar
**Then** the URL matches `/movies`
**And** at least **12** content tiles are visible once the page's carousels finish loading

## Scenario 3: Clicking a tile on the Movies page opens a detail page

**Given** the user is on the Movies page with content tiles loaded
**When** they click the first content tile
**Then** the URL matches `/movies/\d+`
**And** a level-1 heading showing the title's name is visible

---

## Suggested additions

- **Browse dropdown sub-tab switching** (Hubs / Popular / Genres / Collections / Networks) — verified these tabs exist and "Hubs" is active by default, but switching tabs and asserting the resulting category-item change was not explored. Out of the requested scope (menu *opening* only).
- **"All Categories" link inside the open Browse dropdown** — present (`menuitem "All Categories"`) but its destination page was not explored.
- **Playing a title from the Movies detail page** — the detail page exposes a "Play" affordance, but the prompt only asked that a tile click "opens a detail page," not that playback starts; testing playback would also pull in `TubiPlayerPage` and extra WAF-sensitive network requests.
- **"You May Also Like" related-tiles carousel on the detail page** — present and populated, but not requested.

## Notes for the generator

- Use the `tubiHome` fixture from `shared/fixtures/index.js` for all three scenarios. No new fixture or Movies-specific page object is required for Scenarios 2–3 — `TubiHomePage.browseMenuItem(name)`, `.contentTiles`, `.waitForCarouselsLoaded()`, and `.openFirstContentTile()` already exist and were exercised live exactly as described (mirrors `tests/m07/02-claude-mcp-result.spec.ts` and `tests/hermetic/tubi-home.spec.ts`).
- Scenario 1 needs two small additions to `TubiHomePage` since only the click action (`browseMenuItem('Browse')`) exists today, not an assertion-side getter: e.g. `browseMenuTrigger` → `page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Browse' })` (assert expanded state via `.toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')`), and `browseCategoriesMenu` → `page.getByRole('menubar', { name: 'Browse Categories' })`.
- Scenario 3 needs a getter for the detail page's `<h1>` title heading (verified live, renders immediately after `openFirstContentTile()` resolves). It's generic across content types, so it can live on `TubiHomePage` next to `openFirstContentTile()`, or move to a small dedicated detail-page adapter (mirroring the existing `TubiPlayerPage`/`TubiLiveTvPage` split) — implementer's call.
- Tag all three generated tests `@desktop-menubar`, matching `tests/m07/02-claude-mcp-result.spec.ts` and `tests/brag/tubi.spec.ts` — `playwright.config.ts`'s `mobile-chrome` project `grepInvert`s this tag since the top menubar isn't exposed on narrow viewports.
- Guard Scenarios 2–3 with `skipOnMobile` / `skipInHeadless` from `shared/test-guards.js`, matching `tests/m07/02-claude-mcp-result.spec.ts` — lazy-loaded tiles need a real renderer and the menubar is desktop-only.
- Route URL checks through `expect(page).toHaveURL(...)` and element checks through `TubiHomePage` getters — never raw `page.locator`/`page.getByRole` calls in the test file itself, per this repo's Page Object Model rule.
- File target: `tests/m07/tubi-browse.spec.ts` — `playwright.config.ts` already `testIgnore`s `m07/**` in CI, matching other live-Tubi specs.
